title: Find the Number of Winning Players
summary: Given the number of players n and a 2D array pick detailing each player's ball picks, determine how many players win by picking more than their respective index number of balls of the same color.
statement: Given the number of players n and a 2D array pick detailing each player's ball picks, determine how many players win by picking more than their respective index number of balls of the same color. Player 0 wins if they pick any ball, Player 1 if they pick at least two, and so on. Return the count of all such winning players.
constraints: Each pick entry [player,color] records one ball of that color obtained by the player.
Player i wins when some color count is strictly greater than i.
Return the number of winning players.
hints: Maintain a color frequency table for each player.
After all picks, inspect whether any frequency for player i exceeds i.
Count players satisfying that existential condition.
The tables preserve exactly the per-player per-color totals used by the win rule.
editorial: The tables preserve exactly the per-player per-color totals used by the win rule.

tests.explanation: Player zero wins with one ball and player one with two matching balls; player two lacks three matching balls.
Player one has no color twice, so no player wins.
